# Eren Elagöz (ErenElagz)

> Mobile & Full-Stack Software Engineer and UI/UX Designer.

## About
Eren Elagöz is a software engineer combining cross-platform mobile development (React Native), modern web & full-stack architecture (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Laravel), and product design (Figma).

- Website: https://erenelagz.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/erenelagz
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/erenelagz
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/ErenElagz
- Email: erenelagoz@gmail.com

## Flagship Products & Work

- [YoFi](https://yofi.dev): Offline-first, privacy-first personal wealth and financial command center unifying Stripe, RevenueCat, Gumroad, crypto, and net worth. Built with React Native & Next.js.
- [SectorOps](https://sectorops.com): Industry-specific business operating systems and centralized operational infrastructure trusted by 18,000+ professionals and operators around the world across construction, logistics, real estate, and healthcare. Built with Next.js & TypeScript.
- [Belen App](https://erenelagz.com/work/): TEKNOFEST 2024 Tourism Technologies Finalist. Mobile tourism assistant combining Gemini AI voice assistant, real-time Augmented Reality historical landmark recognition, and personalized GPS route planning across Turkiye. Built with React Native & Laravel.
- [AgroSphere](https://agrospheree.vercel.app/): TÜBİTAK 1812 BİGG Finalist autonomous smart agriculture robotics venture combining aerial SkySense UAVs and ground Terra UGVs with edge computer vision (<15ms inference latency) and LoRaWAN telemetry.
- [CoreFound](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.corefound): Real-time founder matching community app released on Google Play Store with GDPR-compliant Firestore schema.
- [Leckham](https://erenelagz.com/leckham/): Minimalist offline e-book reader rated 4.8★ across 25+ countries.

## Technical Stack & Expertise

- Mobile: React Native, Expo, Redux Toolkit, Reanimated, Android, Offline Caching, Google Maps API
- Web & Full-Stack: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Laravel (PHP)
- Databases & Cloud: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase / Firestore, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, Coolify
- AI & Embedded: Google Gemini API, Edge Deep Learning, Computer Vision, LoRaWAN, IoT
- Design: UI/UX Architecture, Design Systems, Interactive Prototyping, Figma, Mobile Store Creatives
